test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The pie-chart below gives the spending of a country on various sports during a particular year as percentages of total spending of all sports by the country in that year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8ef09c17f58050ee81ae6ad8de464dd55d75ec6eb3f456eeca53c12c7729d3.png] 

 

Based on the information given in the pie-chart, find the total amount spent (in crores of rupees) by the country on volleyball and gymnastic taken together in that year, if the total spending by the country in that year on all sports taken together was ₹286 crores.
solution:
**Given:**

Total amount spent that year = Rs. 286 crores

**Calculations:**

Money spent on volleyball = 14% of 286 crores

= 0.14 × 286 crores

Money spent on gymnastics = 12% of 286 crores

= 0.12 × 286 crores

Total amount spent on volleyball and gymnastics together

= 0.14 × 286 crores + 0.12 × 286 crores

= (0.14 + 0.12) × 286 crores

= 0.26 × 286 crores

= 74.36 crores

**∴** The Required amount is Rs. 74.36 crores.
